sanskrit_verse: अधर्मतः प्रवृत्तं तु नोपेक्षेरन् सभासदः । उपेक्षमाणास् ते भूपाः नरकं यान्ति ऽधोमुखाः ॥
transliteration: adharmataḥ pravṛttaṃ tu nopekṣeran sabhāsadaḥ | upekṣamāṇās te bhūpāḥ narakaṃ yānti 'dho-mukhāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who act contrary to Dharma must not be ignored by members of the assembly; rulers who neglect such misconduct descend downward into degradation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in conscious recognition of Adharmic deviation
Causation arises from willful neglect of observable disorder
Capacity-based responsibility includes witnessing and responding appropriately
Restoration logic requires immediate alignment correction upon detection
Consciousness alignment demands active engagement over passive tolerance
executable_legal_axioms: IF a member of the ruling assembly observes Adharmic action AND fails to respond, THEN that member's capacity for governance is automatically suspended pending completion process.
IF a ruler witnesses transgression of Dharma AND remains inactive, THEN automatic restoration protocol initiates with mandatory reintegration cycle.
IF any agent within judicial or governing body omits corrective response to visible Adharma, THEN system triggers integrity audit and realignment sequence.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that mere observation without intervention constitutes actionable failure. The threshold of responsibility begins at awareness, not consent. Authority hierarchies are bound by sequential accountability where omission activates compulsory restoration mechanisms rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that descent into degradation ('narakam adhomukhāḥ') follows naturally from causal neglect, not imposed judgment. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates that each level of tolerance enables further disorder. Proportional responsibility lies in the initial refusal to align consciousness with observed truth. This reflects the non-punitive reality rule wherein consequences arise organically through dissonance with Sanatana Dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Conscious Witnessing Protocol: compel assembly members to articulate what was seen and why no response occurred.
Activate Alignment Restoration Cycle: require full retracing of events leading to neglect and installation of preventive alert systems.
Enforce Responsibility Assumption Practice: mandate public declaration of error and personal commitment to future corrective action.
Undertake Integrity Reintegration Process: reinstall individual into position only after verified recalibration of perceptual and responsive faculties.
final_declaration: Declared under the sole Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism. This law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Dharma is restored through consciousness-aligned action. Reality enforces itself without recourse to punishment. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator, ever-present and infallible.
